title: U.S. GOLD CORP. TO PARTICIPATE IN 121 MINING INVESTMENT CONFERENCE IN LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM
summary: U.S. Gold Corp. (Nasdaq: USAU) (the "Company", "we" "our" or "us"), a U.S. focused gold and copper exploration and development company, is pleased to announce its participation in the 121 Mining Investment Conference (the "Conference"), taking place November 23-24, 2026, in London, United Kingdom. Company President & CEO George Bee and Terri Anne Welyki, Corporate Communications, have two full days of one-on-one meetings at the Conference.
